title: herdr-peers merged claims report (claims-report-v1)
description: What `herdr-peers debate claims --json` prints. Status per claim: established (>= min_lanes supporters, no disputer, a FACT with a source, >= 2 distinct sources), agreed (enough supporters, evidence bar not met), contested (supporters and disputers), partial (2 or more supporters, fewer than min_lanes), single (one supporter), unsupported (disputers only, fewer than min_lanes), disputed (>= min_lanes disputers, no supporter, evidence bar not met), refuted (>= min_lanes disputers, no supporter, a disputing FACT with a source, >= 2 distinct disputing sources). Statuses are a quorum of lanes and their self-declared evidence, never a verification (`basis`); supporters' and disputers' sources, FACT counts and median confidences are reported separately. Lanes are named without a `local:` prefix; with --rounds a lane's later ledger overrides its earlier one claim by claim; with --anonymous lanes are Lane_A..., angles Angle_A..., vendors null, and identities are redacted from claim text and sources. Ordered by that status list, then supporters, disputers and key. Producers may add keys within a schema version; consumers must ignore unknown keys.

basis.description: What the statuses rest on: a quorum of lanes and their self-declared evidence; no source is opened.
